notes.title: Astro Duel 2 - Announcement and Trailer
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=XMn5cNqHXD0;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Astro Duel returns![/b] Prepare for an arena combat game set in the open frontiers of the Echo System. A versus and co-op experience that blurs the line between top-down space shooter and platform fighter. Classic arcade action built with fresh, fluid mechanics.

And make sure to [b]add Astro Duel 2 to your wishlist[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/655350/
